<reason>CON won by holding a single counterexample the proposition as written cannot survive: a narrow standing ban on encampments blocking a clinic entrance, enforced by notice/removal with feasible outdoor relocation but without shelter, storage program, or services. PRO conceded that rule is justified, then relabeled it traffic control/movement and stretched permission to camp into shelter+storage+services, which concedes lawful-alternative is enough and abandons the only-when package.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON's Rebuttal 1/Rebuttal 2 line that noncriminal enforcement does not stop legislation being legislation, so PRO's conceded doorway rule is a justified anti-encampment law without the full package, directly collapsing PRO's universal condition.</best_rebuttal>
